items.title: Tech stocks today: SpaceX lockup ends, Google faces AI leadership shakeup
items.summary: Tech stocks coverage for the week of Aug. 3.

items.title: The companies defying macro uncertainty and raising guidance: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Investors have plenty of reasons to be uncertain right now. But that has not wholly shaken companies' faith in their ability to deliver strong earnings growth this year.

items.title: Nvidia at $212: The No-Brainer Reason to Take Advantage of Nvidia Right Now
items.summary: Nvidia's earnings are compounding at triple-digit rates while its forward multiple sits in the low 20s, a mismatch that rarely lasts long. Here is what the numbers reveal about whether the current price represents a window or a warning.

items.title: MU, WDC, SKHY, AMD — VanEck’s Nicholas Frasse Downplays Volatility In Semiconductor Stocks, Says Chip Trade Is Still Very Strong
items.summary: During an interview with CNBC, Frasse said that the current downturn and volatility in chip and memory stocks is just a reversion to the mean more than anything else.

items.title: High Beta Runners Up: Why AMD and Marvell Technology Now Command Attention
items.summary: AMD and Marvell have both crushed earnings while lapping NVIDIA and Broadcom on year-to-date returns, but their strategies for capturing AI infrastructure spending point in completely opposite directions, and only one of them fits every type of investor.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise But Techs Fall As Sandisk, Western Digital, Datadog Lead Earnings Losers
items.summary: The Dow Jones hit a new high thanks to Nvidia, but Google, SpaceX and AMD weighed on the Nasdaq. Sandisk, Western Digital fell late.

items.title: Wall Street set for mixed open after sentiment rebounds in European trading
items.summary: By Elizabeth Howcroft PARIS, Aug 6 (Reuters) - Investor sentiment rebounded during European trading on Thursday, helped by optimism about company earnings, but Wall Street was set for a mixed opening,

items.title: Load Up On AMD Because Its High Beta Will Reward You Now
items.summary: AMD's brutal 2.49 beta has punished shareholders for years, but at this stage of the AI capex cycle, that same volatility becomes a weapon. The question is whether the current entry point captures the upside before the next catalyst or hands you a painful lesson in timing.
